title: Lower Body
rows: Goblet squat or leg press (moderate depth)
note: Primes the tendon without digging into recovery ahead of Thursday's hard session.

title: Upper Body + Easy Run
runText:
Easy Run · 5.5km
Target RPE 3–4, conversational pace. Doesn't compete with the lifting — legs stay fresh.

title: Rest
restText: No structured training. Optional light walk or mobility work if you feel like moving.

title: Run — Tempo / Hills / Time Trial
tag: Hard session · varies weekly per Runna
runText:
Hard run day
Follow Runna's prescribed structure for the week (tempo, hills, or time trial). Target RPE 7–8 on the working portions. This is one of the two key quality sessions.

title: Lower Body
note: 48h after Thursday's hard run, 48h before Sunday's long run — Saturday's easy run sits as a buffer in between.

title: Upper Body + Easy Run
runText:
Easy Run · 5km
Target RPE 3–4. Second lifted easy-run day of the week.

title: Run — Long Run
runText:
Long Run · progressive
Start easy (RPE 4–5) and build to a stronger finish (RPE 7–8) over the closing portion. Second key quality session of the week.
